title: test(cli): load the os doctor suites' oclif Config without the command scan (#23181 slice 8)
body:
Part of #23181 (slice 8). The card is a series and stays open.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Rows this PR addresses

Eight `@objectstack/cli` unit-tier rows from the card's table, the `os doctor` in-process suites. They share one cause, which this PR removes:

| file (unit tier) | card CI reading | local before (3 runs) | local after (3 runs) | after / before (medians) | CI reading × ratio | status |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| `src/commands/doctor-ledger-read-failure.test.ts` | 17.0 s | 34.35 / 28.07 / 26.37 | 16.50 / 13.85 / 13.03 | 0.49 | 8.4 s | reduced, projected under 10 s, not proven |
| `src/commands/doctor-ledger-posture-independence.test.ts` | 16.6 s | 24.46 / 29.89 / 27.00 | 17.37 / 15.12 / 14.69 | 0.56 | 9.3 s | reduced, projected under 10 s, not proven |
| `src/commands/doctor-unexamined-spec-tree.test.ts` | 14.3 s | 18.02 / 18.65 / 19.55 | 10.41 / 11.20 / 11.12 | 0.60 | 8.5 s | reduced, projected under 10 s, not proven |
| `src/commands/doctor-node-env-default.test.ts` | 14.0 s | 24.42 / 18.29 / 18.08 | 13.00 / 13.86 / 14.47 | 0.76 | 10.6 s | reduced, **not closed** |
| `src/commands/doctor-deprecation-hint-commands.test.ts` | 11.6 s | 13.70 / 17.26 / 14.19 | 7.03 / 6.64 / 6.91 | 0.49 | 5.6 s | done |
| `src/commands/doctor-config-load-cause.test.ts` | 11.6 s | 13.58 / 12.94 / 14.16 | 6.41 / 6.50 / 5.77 | 0.47 | 5.5 s | done |
| `src/commands/doctor-ledger-dir-authority.test.ts` | 10.3 s | 18.78 / 19.57 / 14.62 | 7.28 / 7.08 / 6.45 | 0.38 | 3.9 s | done |
| `src/commands/doctor-config-env-overlay.test.ts` | 10.2 s | 12.23 / 11.89 / 12.32 | 5.37 / 5.01 / 4.71 | 0.41 | 4.2 s | done |

The pin is the card's: the next landed refresh's per-file list no longer names a "done" row. The "projected" rows rest on a ratio applied to the card's old CI reading, so CI decides them, not this table.

## The cause and the fix

Each suite drives the real command with `Doctor.run(argv, { root: CLI_ROOT })`. Given a root, oclif loads a fresh `Config`. `@objectstack/cli` ships no `oclif.manifest.json`, so that load builds the command manifest by importing every compiled command under `dist/commands` (73 commands). Measured in-process: **6.6 s** for that `Config.load`, paid by each file's first test. `doctor.ts` never reads `this.config`, so the command list is pure overhead for these suites.

`packages/cli/src/utils/__tests__/doctor-config.ts` (new, 36 lines) loads one `Config` per file from the package's own `package.json` with only `oclif.commands` dropped. Hooks still load (the `preparse` separator strip is present: `hooks` = `["preparse"]`), and the load takes 36 ms. The eight files pass `await doctorConfig()` instead of `{ root: CLI_ROOT }` (12 call sites) and drop the now-unused `CLI_ROOT` / `HERE` / `fileURLToPath` lines.

- It lives under `src/**/__tests__/`, the path `tsconfig.build.json` already excludes, next to `src/utils/__tests__/server-body.ts`. It is not under `test/helpers/`, because `tsconfig.json`'s `rootDir: src` refuses a `src/` test importing from `test/` (TS6059, measured). It is not under `src/commands/`, because `environments.test.ts` walks every `.ts` there as a command source and would have modelled a phantom `__tests__ doctor-config` command id (measured: the unit tier went from 4812 to 4813 tests).
- No test was deleted, renamed or re-tiered, and no timeout changed. All 139 tests pass in every run, with test full names identical before and after, file by file.

## Why these rows (A2: win per changed line)

One 36-line helper plus 12 one-line call-site swaps (+57 / −48) removes 6.6 s from each of eight rows and brings four under the line. Rows looked at and not taken:

- The `@objectstack/cli` integration files at 90 to 301 s (`data-commands.absent-database`, `stack-conversion-record-door`, `package-install-local-*`, ...). Each spawns the real CLI per fixture. Their fix is either a per-file restructuring or the `test-budget:` header method (slice 6), and that method needs a CI reading this container could not obtain (see A1).
- `test/scaffold-emission-typechecks.test.ts` (unit, 33.3 s): a type-graph compile, a `test-budget` class candidate, so the same CI-reading constraint applies.
- `migrate-meta-*` and `explain-rule-id` unit rows (10.2 to 18.1 s): not measured in this slice.
- The other packages' rows: slices 1 to 5 and 7 took `runtime`, `client`, `verify`, `rest` and `create-objectstack`.

## A1: the work list

PR #25409 (`97be89bb3b`), the newest landed refresh, carries **no per-file list**: its `--diff` refused (exit 1) on `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/audit-mail-bodies.archive.integration.test.ts:2` (`test-budget: 85`, off the 10 s grid). `origin/main` at `e649c2d9` already reads `90` there, so the next refresh can list files. Reproducing the diff locally was not possible: the `test-core-timings-N-of-6` captures are retained one day, so only 2 of the window's 8 runs still had them, and this container's proxy refuses the artifact blob host (HTTP 403). So the rows above come from the card's table, each re-measured on `e649c2d9` (every one still read over 10 s locally before the change).

## What the remaining time is (for the next slice)

Measured per warm `Doctor.run` (about 0.6 to 0.9 s): the three real tool probes `pnpm -v` (0.4 to 0.9 s under vitest's PATH), `tsc -v` (0.1 to 0.4 s) and `git --version` (about 15 ms). On top of that, each file's first run pays the lazy `@objectstack/cloud-connection` import (4.3 s). The files still near or over the line are the ones with 13 to 18 runs. Stubbing the probes is a separate decision, because the suites then stop seeing the real probe rows. It is not taken here.

## Proof

- Measurement, same way before and after: `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c 'cd packages/cli && pnpm exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=json --outputFile=FILE' + the 8 files`. Per-file = the json reporter's `endTime − startTime` (the per-file module line CI reports; it sums to vitest's `tests` total). "Before" restored the 8 files from `e649c2d9` (tree only), then restored from `HEAD` (`git diff HEAD` empty afterwards). Shared box: absolute seconds are box readings, so ratios are the comparable figure.
- Shared fixture check: the helper is new and only these eight files import it. `doctor.ts` and every other `Doctor.run` suite (`doctor-env-provenance`, `doctor-tenancy-posture-report`) are untouched.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck` OK): exit 0 at `f0e74dd1d`. The `--noEmit` program includes the helper; the build program (`tsconfig.build.json --listFilesOnly`, 1318 files, `doctor.ts` among them) includes nothing under `__tests__`.
- cli unit tier at `f0e74dd1d`: 326/327 files, 4811/4812 tests. The one failure is `src/utils/boot-preparation-parity.test.ts`, a 5 s vitest timeout under load (9.15 s) in a file this diff does not touch. Re-run alone: 37/37, exit 0. The two earlier full runs passed it (327/327). The integration tier is declared to CI: the diff touches no integration file and no spawn entry.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `f0e74dd1d`: 58 commands, all exit 0. `--ran`: "58 derived, 58 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
- `eslint --no-inline-config packages/cli`: exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`, the whole repo): exit 0 at `f0e74dd1d`.

## Changeset

`skip-changeset`: nothing published changes. Every changed file is a `*.test.ts` or sits under `src/**/__tests__/`, which `tsconfig.build.json` excludes, so no changed file reaches `dist/` (`files: ["dist", ...]`).

## Acceptance notes

- `@objectstack/cli` ships no `oclif.manifest.json`, so any `Config.load` from the package root imports every command. Whether the published `os` binary pays the same cost per invocation was NOT MEASURED here. This is an observation only.
- `src/utils/boot-preparation-parity.test.ts` "every SERVE_ONLY entry is still used by serve.ts" ran 9.15 s against vitest's 5 s default in one contended full-tier run. Observed once.
